name: dots
description: Repo-wide dev tooling for the dotfiles: Prettier formatting, Claude hook type checks and tests, agent skill/hook validation, Markdown linting. Never stowed into $HOME.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:json && pnpm check:skills && pnpm check:shell && pnpm check:install && pnpm check:herdr
scripts.check:shell: bash -n .config/herdr/scripts/*.sh .config/herdr-app/scripts/*.sh .config/hypr/scripts/*.sh .local/bin/tmux-cht.sh && find .agents/skills -type f -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -r bash -n && shellcheck -x .config/herdr/scripts/*.sh .config/herdr-app/scripts/*.sh .config/hypr/scripts/*.sh .local/bin/tmux-cht.sh && find .agents/skills -type f -name '*.sh' -print0 | xargs -0 -r shellcheck
